tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The window background. Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The sidebar column: one step darker than canvas, so content sits forward.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Section cards and sheets: the surface content lives on.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and anything that floats; always with border-subtle and shadow-raised.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Fill of a row, menu item or plain button under the pointer.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Fill of the chosen row or option. Pair with text for its label.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Divides; never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Text field and control outlines, where a visible edge is needed.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Titles, rule patterns, profile names: what the eye lands on.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy, the words around a value ("Open", "in"), menu text.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Meta: folder names, timestamps, file paths, captions.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only. Below 4.5:1; never for content.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one primary action in a view (Done, Make Default Browser) and the switch tint.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button under the pointer or pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and text buttons.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet wash behind a selected chip or an info banner, with accent-text on it.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Second brand hue, from the icon's second path. Illustration and profile colour only; never a state.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral as text, for example a highlighted word in docs.

tokens.name: coral-tint
tokens.usage: Coral wash for illustration backgrounds.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Granted, loaded, routed: text and glyphs, always beside a word.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a success badge, with success on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention but still works: text and glyphs, always beside a word.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a warning banner, with warning or text on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed or refused: text and glyphs, always beside a word.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of an error banner, with danger or text on it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px, on every focusable control.

tokens.name: tile-ink
tokens.usage: Sidebar icon tile behind a white symbol, for code and advanced pages. The same in both themes, like System Settings' tiles.

tokens.name: tile-neutral
tokens.usage: Sidebar icon tile behind a white symbol, for general settings. The same in both themes.

tokens.name: tile-violet
tokens.usage: Sidebar icon tile behind a white symbol, for the Agents page. The same in both themes.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: The window title. Once per window.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Open domains matching example.com in Work
styles.usage: Everything you read: rows, descriptions, menus. The macOS standard size.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The value in a sentence: a rule's pattern, a profile name.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta under or beside a value. The smallest readable size.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a dot and its label; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between words and controls in a rule row; list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in a card; banner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the gap between a section title and its card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Window padding and the gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Sheet padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text fields, small buttons, key hints.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, banners, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Section cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Profile chips and status badges.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Section cards: barely there, so the page stays airy.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and sheets.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of every button, field and select.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of the buttons that finish a sheet (Cancel, Done, Add).

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Height of a sidebar row.

tokens.name: size-tile
tokens.usage: Sidebar icon tile: a white symbol on a coloured rounded square.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the sidebar column.
